**Finding: deviation (high severity, licence scope) — §2 Grant of License (p0028)**

- **Compliant aspects:** the grant already extends to Sparkling's affiliated companies operating at Authorized Locations, and §17(a) makes it perpetual so long as fees are paid, with §17(c) converting it to a fee-free perpetual licence on Garman's default — so it is not revocable at Garman's discretion.
- **Gaps:** (i) contractors acting on our behalf are not covered (and §3(g) only carves out affiliates); (ii) the licence is expressly "non-transferable", reinforced by §3(c) and §20(d) which require Garman's consent for any assignment or transfer, so the licence would not follow our business in an M&A transaction.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** insert contractors acting on Sparkling's behalf into the grant and delete "non-transferable", replacing it with a right to transfer to a successor by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, notwithstanding §§3(c) and 20(d). Fallback offered in the comment: affiliates/contractors added on written notice.
